item.title: OpenAI Disrupts Poipet Scam Network Using ChatGPT Across Multiple Fraud Schemes
item.summary: OpenAI said it disrupted a Cambodia-based scam operation that used its generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot ChatGPT to facilitate a wide range of investment, romance, gambling, and law enforcement impersonation schemes.
